purpose: Descriptive extraction of every component and dependency from NKE v0.21.0; not an executable catalog or pin lock.

sourceBuildPolicy.publicSource: Compile from pinned Git; a build failure is not permission to acquire a prebuilt replacement.
sourceBuildPolicy.unavailablePublicSource: Retain the existing digest-pinned acquired input, declare the exception beside the catalog entry and report it during preparation.
sourceBuildPolicy.acquisitionFailure: Fail closed on missing, inaccessible or digest-mismatching bytes; do not omit the component.

exceptions.reason: The release SBOM has no source URL, source commit or version; current GitHub checks did not establish an accessible public source.
exceptions.accessObservation: 2026-10-07 anonymous HEAD requests returned HTTP 403 on both existing URLs; payload bytes were not reauthenticated.
exceptions.implementationStatus: Proposed catalog migration; not yet wired into executable inputs.
